:::{#sol-cross-entropy-general-self}

By [the expectation form of cross-entropy](#thm-cross-entropy-expectation) with $q = p$,
$H(p, p) = \E{-\log p_X}$.
Since $\P(X = k) = p_k$, we have $-\log p_X = \surprisalf{X}$, the [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of $X$.
This is finite with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) 1, because $X$ takes only values with $p_k > 0$.
So $H(p, p) = \E{\surprisalf{X}} = \entropyf{X}$ by the definition of [entropy](#def-entropy).

:::
